milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the redstone block (placed at spawn-relative [5, 1, 8] inside the stone brick building) and face toward it, confirming they can see it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range (the building entrance is about 3 blocks from the redstone block, and the player spawns about 9 blocks away). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the block rather than facing away, modeling visual observation.
